comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few comparable resales for a price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few comparable resales for a price comparison.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: Not available: under 12 months of resale history.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Newton MRT about 420 m, Orchard MRT about 610 m; closer than 279 of 551 similar developments (the same as 8). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 7 within 2 km; nearest Anglo-Chinese School (Junior) about 540 m; more than 107 of 551 similar developments (the same as 202). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 10 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 490 m), more than 462 of 551 similar developments (the same as 53); nearest hawker centre Newton Food Centre about 500 m; nearest park Mount Emily Park about 1,240 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (21 Anderson, 6 new sales, about 980 m; Sanctuary@Newton, 16 new sales, about 990 m; 32 Gilstead, 3 new sales, about 1,000 m; Grange 1866, 6 new sales, about 1,290 m; Orchard Sophia, 13 new sales, about 1,300 m; Park Nova, 4 new sales, about 1,310 m; The Giverny Residences, 2 new sales, about 1,470 m; Duet @ Emily, 3 new sales, about 1,550 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 484 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 727 new sales and 1,321 resales (2,048 purchases); new sales were 35.5% of these purchases. Subsales (56) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Peck Hay Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 240 m; Bukit Timah Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 470 m; upcoming Sophia Meadow development, about 1,270 m; Dorset Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,990 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 1,321 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 504 of 551 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 1,321 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,439 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−8.2%). Planning-area private resales +16%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
